pages.title: Shared Levels
pages.text: Beasts and puppets share a 0–20 curve: next level costs $(l)20 + 10×current level$(). Stage semantics stay domain-specific.

pages.title: Beast Feeding
pages.text: Nurture pills, feed, cores, shards and combat grant weighted XP and affinity. Evolution thresholds come from authored stage counts and require an $(l)operational Spirit Beast Evolution Pool$(). Full-affinity threshold retries without a pool do not consume feed. Legacy Growth maps cleanly.

pages.title: Puppet Refinement
pages.text: All seven craft recipes map to persistent owner cores. Assembly, hits, kills and repairs advance XP; levels 7/14/20 refine at a $(l)Puppet Core Forge$(). Death clone keeps progress; multipliers apply on later summons.

pages.title: Entry Notes
pages.text: Capture jars only seal bestiary-tameable ecology beasts at ≤35% health. Puppet craft needs the matching blueprint as knowledge (not consumed) plus full materials.
